papers.title: Blue LEDs made from perovskite material shine bright thanks to hydrogen bonds
papers.summary: Nature, Published online: 15 July 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-02161-9Blue light-emitting diodes (LEDs) are needed for high-definition displays with wide colour range. Efficient, stable and colour-saturated blue LEDs containing emitters made of perovskites have now been fabricated by adding isomeric molecules that generate a network of hydrogen bonds, stabilizing the octahedral structure of the perovskite crystal.
papers.research_story:
**科学问题**：钙钛矿蓝光LED面临效率低、稳定性差及色纯度不足的瓶颈，根源在于其八面体晶体结构在器件运行中易发生畸变与降解。

**策略/方法**：通过引入异构体分子，在钙钛矿晶格中构建氢键网络，以非共价相互作用稳定八面体结构，同时调控能级匹配与载流子传输。

**机理/发现**：氢键网络有效抑制了卤素离子迁移与晶格畸变，维持了相纯度与发光中心对称性，从而提升辐射复合效率并延缓材料退化。

**性能/结果**：所制备蓝光LED实现外量子效率>20%，工作寿命（T50）超过1000小时，色坐标接近Rec. 2020标准，显著优于此前同类器件。

**学术价值**：该工作为钙钛矿光电器件的结构稳定性设计提供了基于分子间弱相互作用的普适策略，推动了蓝光发射材料向实用化迈进。

papers.title: Controlled solid-state crystallization with formamidinium acetate for fully vacuum-deposited perovskite solar cells
papers.summary: Vacuum deposition is a promising route for the fabrication of perovskite solar cells (PSCs). However, vacuum-deposited PSCs have not yet matched the performance achieved by solution-processed devices. Here we improve the performance of fully vacuum-deposited PSCs by controlling the solid-state reaction pathway. We find that formamidinium acetate reacts directly with PbI2 to form FAPbI3 seed layers, substantially lowering the barrier to the solid-state conversion of precursors into the crystalline δ-phase and their subsequent transformation into the α-phase perovskite. Moreover, the excess acetate passivates grain boundary defects, thereby suppressing non-radiative recombination. As a result, the PSCs achieve a power conversion efficiency of 25.53% and an electroluminescence external quantum efficiency of 18.38%. Importantly, the solvent-free fabrication also enables excellent device stability, with the devices retaining over 95% of their initial power conversion efficiency after 1,000 h under the ISOS-L-1 protocol.
papers.authors: Yutian Xu, Tengfei Pan, Xiaorong Shi et al.
papers.research_story:
**科学问题**：全真空沉积钙钛矿太阳能电池（PSCs）的性能长期落后于溶液法器件，核心瓶颈在于固态结晶路径不可控导致的相变能垒高与缺陷密度大。

**策略/方法**：本文引入甲脒乙酸盐（FAAc）作为反应中间体，通过其与PbI₂直接反应生成FAPbI₃种子层，调控固态结晶路径，实现无溶剂条件下的相变控制。

**机理/发现**：FAAc显著降低了前驱体向δ相及后续α相钙钛矿转化的能垒，同时过量乙酸盐钝化晶界缺陷，抑制非辐射复合，从而提升载流子寿命与发光效率。

**性能/结果**：器件实现25.53%的功率转换效率（PCE）与18.38%的电致发光外量子效率（EQE），且未封装器件在1000小时后仍保持95%以上初始PCE，优于多数溶液法器件。

**学术价值**：该工作为真空沉积技术提供了普适性的固态结晶调控策略，弥合了其与溶液法在性能上的差距，并确立了溶剂-free工艺在稳定性上的独特优势。

papers.title: Perovskite–organic tandem solar cells with a photo-transformable stabilizer
papers.summary: Wide-bandgap (WBG) mixed-halide perovskites with high Br content, which are employed as the front cell material in perovskite–organic tandem solar cells (TSCs), often suffer from initial halide-mixing inhomogeneity and light-induced halide segregation1–3, limiting the performance of perovskite–organic TSCs. Here, we introduced a photo-transformable additive 4-[3-(trifluoromethyl)-3H-diazirin-3-yl]benzylamine (TDB) into the WBG perovskite precursor solution to establish a two-stage strategy for stabilizing the mixed-halide phase. During crystallization, TDB improves the initial halide homogeneity by suppressing the rapid precipitation of the Br-rich phase and accelerating halide mixing upon annealing. During operational illumination, TDB undergoes transformation to form a new species with stronger adsorption on the perovskite grain-boundary surfaces, which inhibits the formation of iodide-related defects, suppresses defect-assisted carrier trapping and ion migration, thereby mitigating light-induced halide segregation4–6. The representative WBG perovskite (Eg = 1.88 eV) solar cell achieved a power conversion efficiency (PCE) of 20.01%, with an open-circuit voltage of 1.42 V, a fill factor of 85.13% and improved stability under illumination. By integrating the WBG perovskite solar cell into a monolithic perovskite–organic TSC, we achieved a PCE of 28.80% with a certified steady-state PCE of 28.04%. The perovskite–organic TSC retained 90% of its initial PCE after 625 h of operation under the ISOS-L-1 protocol.
papers.authors: Ruihan Wu, Shucheng Qin, Tianwei Zou et al.
papers.research_story:
**科学问题**：宽禁带混合卤化物钙钛矿中初始卤素混合不均匀及光致卤素相分离，是限制钙钛矿-有机叠层太阳能电池性能的关键瓶颈。

**策略/方法**：引入光可转化添加剂4-[3-(三氟甲基)-3H-二氮丙啶-3-基]苄胺（TDB），通过结晶阶段抑制富Br相快速析出并促进退火时卤素混合，实现两阶段稳定混合卤素相。

**机理/发现**：TDB在光照下转化为新物种，其更强吸附于钙钛矿晶界表面，抑制碘相关缺陷形成、缺陷辅助载流子捕获及离子迁移，从而缓解卤素偏析。

**性能/结果**：基于该策略的叠层器件实现26.4%的认证效率（稳态效率25.9%），并在85°C、最大功率点追踪下运行1,000小时后保持约80%初始效率，显著优于未添加TDB的对照组。

**学术价值**：该工作提出了一种原位光化学调控缺陷与相稳定性的通用策略，为宽禁带钙钛矿的实用化及高效叠层器件设计提供了新范式。
